attempted_claim: Let X_6 be a very general smooth sextic threefold in P^4(C). There exists an explicitly exhibited nonzero invariant logarithmic jet differential P in H^0(X_6, E_{3,m0} T^*_{X_6} tensor O_{X_6}(-a0)) for explicit integers m0,a0, vanishing on an explicit ample divisor A, such that every nonconstant entire holomorphic curve f:C->X_6 satisfies P(f)=0 and is therefore contained in a fixed proper algebraic subvariety Y subset X_6 (quasi-Brody degeneracy for X_6).
claim_type: effective hyperbolicity degeneracy fragment with jet-differential vanishing witness
decisive_failure: Obstruction uses published Rousseau/Merker leading-term polynomials; banked d=6 constants are recomputations of the known d>=97 threshold, not an original finding. No full impossibility proof over all (m,a) is claimed.
